description: RFC-0001 fleet checkpoint log, EXPERIMENTAL (0.6.0 prototype; not part of the specification's conformance set). fleet_log: four agent checkpoint notes as a fleet log appends them (entries_b64), their RFC 6962 leaf hashes SHA256(0x00 || entry bytes), the fleet root, the inclusion proof for entry 2 (hex, innermost first) and the fleet checkpoint note signed by the fleet key (fleet_vkey). Cases: run each named dossier through your verifier with the trusted directory when trusted_directory is true, subject_org, threshold, min_witnesses (when not null it replaces the threshold gate) and the fleet-anchor opt-in when accept_fleet_anchor is true. The verdict, exit code (11 when split_view_unsafe and allow_sub_majority is false), quorum valid_receipts and distinct_independent_operators (null when there is no quorum), fleet_anchor.status and fleet_anchor.fleet_tree_size (null when the report has no fleet_anchor) must equal expect. With the opt-in the report must carry witnessed_via ("direct" | "fleet" | "both", null unless the verdict is witnessed) and witness_paths equal to expect; without it the report must carry neither key. The fleet operator's organisation is subject_org; witnesses of it never count as independent, and with the opt-in but no subject_org the anchor fails. Each witness key counts once across both paths; only keys with a direct receipt count toward split-view resistance. Every key here is public and for testing only.
